RE: 2ND CAUSE OF ACTION IS OFF CALENDAR PURSUANT TO PLAINTIFF'S AGREEMENT TO DISMISS THIS CAUSE OF ACTION. RE: 3RD CAUSE OF ACTION IS OVERRULED; THE FACT THAT PERSON IS A PARTNER AT A LAW FIRM DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY EXCLUDE THE INDIVIDUAL FROM FEHA PROTECTION. FACTS ALLEGED HERE COULD STATE A FEHA CLAIM BY DECEASED PARTNER; MOREOVER, THE SEXUAL ORIENTATION PROVISION OF FEHA CAN APPLY HERE. SEE MURRAY V. OCEANSIDE UNIFIED SCHOOL DIST., 79 CA4 1338 (2000).
